I regret buying a puppy from a puppy mill initially. However, I did purchase a 23-month-old Yorkie who had been completely neglected and lived in poor conditions. Despite these circumstances, they sold him to me for an insane $600.

I’ve spent a significant amount of money on grooming and getting him back to health. Surprisingly, he wasn’t even trained to walk on a leash. It seems that he wasn’t a popular puppy, so they simply discarded him and handed him over to the first person who came along. Thankfully, it was me who rescued this beautiful baby.

If you’re considering getting a puppy from a puppy mill, I strongly advise you to adopt first. Avoid places like these Jack-in-the-Box establishments that prioritize profit over the well-being of animals. It’s absolutely ridiculous that they had a dog for $4000.
